fixer.title: session: Improve reference popup placement consistency

introducer.title: sessions: add rich GitHub reference previews

cases.mechanism: Opening a collection eagerly constructed the first tab-through preview; for image entries this also initiated a file read of up to 20 MiB, and for GitHub entries it allocated/rendered the full rich-card DOM before the user requested details.
cases.symptom: Collection opening incurred unnecessary filesystem I/O, allocation, and layout work for the initially highlighted item, increasing open latency and resource use even when the user never viewed the preview.
cases.fixedBehavior: Opening an ActionList now only focuses/highlights the initial row. Rich hover construction and any image file read are deferred until pointer intent or explicit keyboard navigation requests the details.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, ActionListWidget.focus() called _showTabThroughPanelForFocusedItem() after focusing the first row. That helper immediately called _showSubmenuForElement for a first item with tabThroughPanel, which invokes element.hover.content(). Chat dropdown image entries implement content() with createChatPillImagePreview, and that function immediately starts fileService.readFile with a 20 MiB limit; GitHub PR/issue content also builds a multi-element rich preview. The changed deletion at base line 1641 removes this work from popup opening, while the changed keyboard/pointer paths still reveal the panel on deliberate interaction.
